verdict.rationale: Windmill documents self-hosting on your own infrastructure (Docker Compose or a Helm chart on Kubernetes), so you decide where the instance and its data live. Community reports confirm people self-host it on chosen servers such as Oracle and Alpine Linux. There is no documented region or data-residency selection for the hosted cloud offering, so residency control comes only from self-deployment. Missing for 10: documented region/residency choice for managed cloud, explicit data-residency documentation or guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: For small setups, use Docker and Docker Compose on a single instance. For larger and production use-cases, use our Helm chart to deploy on Kubernetes.
Windmill is an open-source and self-hostable workflow engine and developer platform
Pretty easy to selfhost as I deployed it on a Alpine Linux server using Podman + Docker Compose binary.
